description:
Use Eclipse's 'Change Method Signature' refactoring tool to modify the API of the PaymentPlatform project.

Goal: Modify the 'processPayment' method in 'PaymentService.java' to add two new parameters with default values, ensuring all 15+ call sites across the project are updated automatically.

Instructions:
1. Open 'src/main/java/com/acme/payment/PaymentService.java' in the Package Explorer.
2. Locate the 'processPayment(String customerId, double amount)' method.
3. Use the 'Change Method Signature' refactoring (Alt+Shift+C or Refactor menu) to add these parameters:
   - Name: 'currency', Type: 'String', Default value: "USD"
   - Name: 'priority', Type: 'boolean', Default value: false
4. Preview and Apply the changes.
5. Save all files and ensure the project compiles without errors.

Note: Do NOT manually find/replace. You must use the Refactoring tool to ensure all call sites are updated correctly.
